name: Ashikaga Takauji
role: Japanese Samurai, Daimyo and Military ruler of Japan from 1338 to 1358
contribution: A Japanese samurai, daimyo and the founder and first shōgun of the Ashikaga shogunate.

checks.lead: Ashikaga Takauji (足利 尊氏; August 18, 1305 – June 7, 1358) also known as Minamoto no Takauji was a Japanese samurai, daimyo and the founder and first shōgun of the Ashikaga shogunate. His rule began in 1338, beginning the Muromachi period of Japan, and ended with his death in 1358. He was a male-line descendant of the samurai of the (Minamoto) Seiwa Genji line (meaning they were descendants of Emperor Seiwa) who had settled in the Ashikaga area of Shimotsuke Province, in present-day Tochigi Prefecture.
